staff_intro: Call one person at a time. Build trust, send staff to school, or let Alice handle renewals. Romance unlocks after more than 4 months together.
alice_staff_profile: Secretary / production planner. Enjoys conversation; chooses to remain single and never dates anyone.
staff_missing: This person is no longer on our team.
social_prompt: Trust %d / Comfort %d / Attraction %d. Choose an activity (one per person each day).
social_talk_result: %s enjoyed the conversation. Trust and comfort improved.
social_party_result: %s had a great evening! Comfort and trust improved.
social_reject: %s politely declined. Timing, trust, compatibility and existing partners matter.
social_flirt_result: %s seems interested. Take time to build the relationship.
social_cooldown: Give them some space. Try again tomorrow.
romance_locked: Spend more than four months working together first (112 game days).
alice_no_romance: Thank you, but I am not interested in romance. I choose to stay single, with everyone. I am happy to be your secretary and friend.
alice_friendly: I am glad we can talk. I will always support our studio as your secretary and friend.
staff_couple: %s and %s chose to start dating. Love is welcome here, regardless of gender.
life_no_money: We do not have enough cash for this choice.
training_prompt: Choose a genre course: %d days / %s. Gain +8 genre skill and +5 XP. The artist cannot record or join meetings until returning.
auto_renew_prompt: Would you like me to renew this artist automatically? Each renewal buys 4 weeks for %s when their contract ends, if we have enough cash. You can change this under Staff.
auto_renew_set: Automatic renewals are now %s. You can change this under Staff.
auto_renew_done: I renewed %s for 4 weeks. Renewal fee: %s.
auto_renew_failed: I could not auto-renew %s because we are short of cash. Please decide how to proceed.
mode_prompt: How shall we compose? Manual lets you arrange genre blocks and tempo with Alice. Auto gives a smaller idea bonus. You still choose the team and recording schedule.
manual_entry_hint: Alice > Timeline > PLAY MANUAL gathers the team in the Lounge and opens the music-maker puzzle.
cloud_missing: No cloud audio yet. Sign in and upload this song from Music Library first.
feedback_resolved: This monthly report was already resolved.
